data.body: Implementation note: for tier 1 in the priority loop, if no reviewer-findings.json artifact found, skip log fallback entirely and continue to tier 2. Tier 1 (llm-review) findings are never emitted to CI log text — calling _fetch_ci_log for tier 1 would wastefully fetch logs and then fail normalization. Add a guard: [[ $_tier -eq 1 ]] && { rm -f "$_tier_normalized"; continue; } when _tier_artifact is empty.
